paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: Illustrating the empirical generalization errors and sharpness measures with respect to QLoRA weights. (<ref>) Smaller adapters with a rank of 16 achieve the lowest generalization errors. Additionally, the Hessian trace values correlate with generalization errors, suggesting that smaller adapters tend to converge to flatter minima. (<ref>) An ensemble of k adapters leads to lower generalization errors and Hessian traces. Here, we fix the sum of the dimensions of k adapters to be equal to 256. (<ref>) QLoRA, which is trained on a quantized base model, yields lower generalization errors and Hessian trace values compared to LoRA.

annotations.annotation: Die Abbildung ist ein Liniendiagramm und veranschaulicht die Beziehung zwischen Rang und Fehlern im COPA-Datensatz. Die horizontale Achse ist beschriftet mit "Rank" und verwendet eine lineare Skala mit Teilstrichen bei 4, 16, 64 und 256 Die vertikale Achse verwendet eine lineare Skala mit einem Bereich von 0.0 bis 0.9 und Teilstrichen im Abstand von 0.3. Das Diagramm besteht aus einer Linie. Diese ist schwarz mit grünen Markierungen und hat bei 4 einen Wert von ungefähr 0.2, bei 16 einen Wert von 0.1, bei 64 einen Wert von 0.15 und bei 256 einen Wert von 0.7. An jeder Markierungsposition sind Fehlerbalken vorhanden.

The plot illustrates the relationship between rank and errors in the COPA task. The x-axis is labeled "Rank" and is exponential, with values at 4, 16, 64, and 256. The y-axis is labeled "Errors" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.6, with tick labels at intervals of 0.3. The plot features a single black solid line that connects data points marked by green circles. At the start of the x-axis, the data point at rank 4 shows an error value of approximately 0.2. As the rank increases to 16, the error value drops to around 0.1, reaching a minimum for this plot. The error value at rank 64 slightly increases to about 0.15. Finally, the error value significantly rises to approximately 0.7 at rank 256. Error bars are present at each marker location to indicate variability

The line plot illustrates the relationship between rank and errors in the COPA dataset. The x-axis is labeled "Rank" and is linear, with values at 4, 16, 64, and 256. The y-axis is labeled "Errors", but the label text is on top center of the plot, and with a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.6, with tick labels at intervals of 0.3. The plot features a single black solid line that connects data points marked by green circles. At the start of the x-axis, the data point at rank 4 shows an error value of approximately 0.2 with some error bars indicating variability. As the rank increases to 16, the error value drops to around 0.15, reaching a minimum for this plot. The error value at rank 64 slightly increases to about 0.15. Finally, the error value significantly rises to approximately 0.65 at rank 256. No legend is given.

Линейната графика илюстрира връзката между ранга и грешките в набора от данни COPA. Оста x е означена като „Ранг“ и е в експоненциален мащаб, със стойности 4, 16, 64 и 256. Оста y е означена като „Грешки“ и е с линеен мащаб, вариращ от 0.0 до 0.6, с означения през интервал от 0.3. Графиката съдържа една черна непрекъсната линия, която свързва точки, отбелязани със зелени кръгове. В началото на оста x, точката при ранг 4 показва стойност на грешката около 0.20, като са налице ленти на грешка, указващи вариация. При увеличение на ранга до 16, стойността на грешката спада до около 0.10, което е и най-ниската стойност в графиката. При ранг 64, грешката леко се покачва до около 0.15. Накрая, при ранг 256, грешката значително нараства до приблизително 0.70.
